description: This file contains unit tests for the HeaderBasedPlaceholderSubstitutionAlgorithm class, verifying its behavior related to placeholder substitution within headers using JUnit tests. It tests scenarios like successful substitution, handling of unknown placeholders, nested placeholders, and immutability.

classes.name: HeaderBasedPlaceholderSubstitutionAlgorithmTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for {@link HeaderBasedPlaceholderSubstitutionAlgorithm}, testing placeholder substitution logic, error handling, and immutability properties.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the test instance with a predefined set of placeholder replacements before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the HeaderBasedPlaceholderSubstitutionAlgorithm instance is immutable.

methods.name: substituteFailsWithNullInput
methods.description: Ensures that passing a null input string throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: substituteFailsWithNullHeaders
methods.description: Ensures that passing null headers (DittoHeaders) throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: substituteFailsWithNullWithDittoHeaders
methods.description: Ensures that passing null WithDittoHeaders throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: substituteReturnsInputWhenInputDoesNotContainReplacers
methods.description: Verifies that non-placeholder strings are returned unchanged.

methods.name: substituteReturnsReplacedWhenInputContainsPlaceholder
methods.description: Checks that placeholders matching defined replacers are correctly substituted.

methods.name: substituteThrowsUnknownPlaceholderExceptionWhenInputContainsUnknownPlaceholder
methods.description: Ensures that unknown placeholders trigger an exception.

methods.name: partialPlaceholdersRemain
methods.description: Tests that incomplete placeholder syntax remains unchanged.

methods.name: unknownLegacyPlaceholderThrowsException
methods.description: Checks that unknown legacy placeholders trigger exceptions.

methods.name: inputContainsNestedLegacyPlaceholderThrowsException
methods.description: Verifies that nested legacy placeholders cause exceptions.

methods.name: assertUnknownPlaceholderExceptionIsThrown
methods.description: Helper method to assert that an unknown placeholder exception is raised with expected message details.

methods.name: assertUnresolvedPlaceholdersRemainExceptionIsThrown
methods.description: Helper to verify that unresolved placeholders are correctly reported as an exception.

methods.name: assertGatewayPlaceholderNotResolvableExceptionIsThrown
methods.description: Asserts that the exception has correct message and description details.
